scenarios.criterion: Given packages/saturday-playwright-leaflet/fixtures/, a static page MUST load Leaflet from the package's own dependencies (no CDN), a local image, and a known set of markers carrying saturdayMetadata, a polygon, and a layer control, and MUST expose window.__SATURDAY_LEAFLET_MAP__.
scenarios.name: Fixture page exposes a fully loaded map with known markers, polygon, and layer control
given: the fixture page at packages/saturday-playwright-leaflet/fixtures/index.html is served locally with no network access
Leaflet is referenced only from the package's own node_modules/leaflet/dist, never a CDN URL
when: the fixture page finishes loading the map, its tile image, and all layers
then: at least 3 markers exist, each carrying saturdayMetadata with an id and a name
one L.polygon exists with fixed, known coordinates
one L.control.layers overlay exists with a fixed, known name

scenarios.criterion: Given the package's test script, it MUST serve the fixture page and run a Playwright suite with at least one test per helper documented in README.md, and each test MUST assert a known value taken from the fixture.
scenarios.name: Every README-documented helper has at least one test asserting a known fixture value
given: the fixture page is served by the package's test script
when: the package's Playwright test suite runs
then: each of the 11 README helpers — waitForMapLoad, getCenter, getBounds, getMarkers, drawLine, getMarkersAlongLine, distanceBetween, isPointInPolygon, assertPopupContent, isLayerVisible, checkTileFailures — has at least one test
each test's assertion matches a known value taken directly from the fixture

scenarios.criterion: Given each helper's test, it MUST fail when the fixture's corresponding value is changed; the delivery record MUST document, per helper, the fixture change made and the resulting failing output.
scenarios.name: Each helper's test fails when its corresponding fixture value is deliberately changed
given: a helper's test passes against the unmodified fixture
when: the fixture value that helper's test depends on is deliberately changed, then that single test is re-run
then: the delivery record documents, for each of the 11 helpers, the exact fixture change made and the resulting failing output

scenarios.criterion: Given the suite, it MUST run in real Chrome (channel: 'chrome') inside the runner image with no network, and MUST pass with the literal docker command below after dependencies are installed and the package is built; the delivery record MUST capture that command's output.
scenarios.name: Suite passes in real Chrome with no network access inside the runner image
given: package dependencies are installed and the package is built
when: the literal command is run: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --network none -v "$PWD:/work" saturday-runner:debian bash -lc 'cd /work && pnpm --filter @orieken/saturday-playwright-leaflet test'
then: the suite runs using real Chrome (channel: 'chrome') with no network access available
the delivery record captures that command's full output

scenarios.criterion: Given the change is complete, every new or changed function MUST have cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line MUST be covered by a test that can fail, and no file outside scope.paths MUST change except the run's own delivery record under docs/features/leaflet-package-tests/.
scenarios.name: Change stays within scope and meets complexity and coverage bars
when: complexity, test coverage, and the set of changed files are checked
then: every new or changed function has cyclomatic complexity below 7
every changed line is covered by a test proven able to fail
no file outside packages/saturday-playwright-leaflet/**, pnpm-lock.yaml, and docs/features/leaflet-package-tests/** changed
